definitions.reference: positive evidence label or derived lack of annotated abstract evidence for an explicitly cited document
definitions.primary_cohort: all 339 official dev cited claim--document pairs; natural cited-pair label mix
definitions.complement: 159 pairs not in prior three-choice 180; 37 positive pairs were in earlier two-choice experiment
definitions.strict_correctness: valid semantic prediction equals reference; invalid/error stays in denominator as not correct
definitions.robust_correct: reference-correct in both base and reversal
definitions.flip: unequal semantic predictions, conditional on both compared outputs valid
definitions.interval: 10,000 paired claim-cluster percentile draws primary; document-cluster sensitivity; fixed dev source only
